messages:
Asha: Pushed rc build rc-2026-04-02-orion (sha: d9a1c2) for embed-service. Small changes: tokenizer tweak, cache key fix, and a heuristic change to similarity-normalization. Notes: https://git.internal/r/3589
Asha: Planning to promote during the 3h change window starting 2026-04-02T01:00Z. Need QA signoff and oncall present. Will pin artifact before promo.
Maya (QA): Kicking off smoke & embedding-quality evals now. Will report back in ~12m.
deploy-bot: pin request queued for rc-2026-04-02-orion at 2026-04-02T00:45:00Z. proposed-pin: p-8c9d
Maya (QA): Smoke: functional checks OK. Embedding drift test shows mean cosine drop ~0.018 on the similarity-suite (threshold was 0.015). Investigating: looks correlated with long docs (>2k tokens).
Asha: Hmm. The tokenizer tweak may affect long documents. Options: hold and hotfix, or proceed with a restricted canary (small region and disable tokenizer tweak via runtime flag). What do folks think?
Raj (oncall): If we can mitigate by runtime flag that disables tokenizer_v2 for long-doc paths, I'm comfortable doing a restricted canary. I'll be oncall for the window. Note maintenance in ap-south at 02:30Z which may affect metrics collection.
Ivo (SRE): We can flip a runtime flag per route `feature.tokenizer_v2=false` via the config service. Quick command ready. Also recommend starting canary in us-east1 only, 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30/30 mins.
Asha: Agree. Exec plan: pin artifact, canary in us-east1 only, enable rc but set feature.tokenizer_v2=false for routes matching /ingest/longdoc, smoke + embed-eval gates. If QA green, we'll ramp and enable token v2 globally next patch.
deploy-bot: pin applied: p-8c9d -> rc-2026-04-02-orion (sha: d9a1c2). canary job created: cj-9921. schedule: 2026-04-02T01:00Z us-east1 1%
Maya (QA): Re-run embed suite with long-doc routes excluded: pass. Short-doc embedding quality within thresholds.
Raj (oncall): Rollback criteria: error-rate > 1.3x baseline for 8m OR p95 latency +30% for 10m OR mean cosine drop > 0.02 on the similarity-suite. Rollback target: previous pinned sha 4b7c9a. Rollback command: ```deploy-bot promote --target sha=4b7c9a --scope=us-east1 --reason="auto-rollback"```
Ivo (SRE): Escape hatch (traffic-shim): `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/v1/traffic-shim -d '{"service":"embed","region":"us-east1","percent":0}'`
Asha: I'll apply the route-level flag prior to promo: configctl set feature.tokenizer_v2 false --route="/ingest/longdoc" --env=prod
Maya (QA): Final ack: smoke + embed-eval green with long-doc routes disabled. Approve canary.
Asha: Starting canary at 01:00Z. Checklist: pinned, QA ack, route-flag applied, oncall ready, rollback command in thread.
Raj (oncall): I'll be monitoring errors, latency, and the similarity-suite metric. Ping @oncall-raj if anything.
deploy-bot: canary cj-9921 started stage=canary percent=1 region=us-east1 status=running
Ivo (SRE): cj-9921 will post telemetry pings to #metrics every 45s. Also warming KV cache for embed caches.
Maya (QA): embedding-suite heartbeat @ 2026-04-02T01:05Z: mean_cosine_drop=0.005, coverage checks ok.
deploy-bot: cj-9921 heartbeat @ 2026-04-02T01:06:00Z: errors=0, p95=98ms, embeddings/sec=2100
Asha: Good start. If metrics stay stable at +20m we'll ramp to 5%. If any drift shows up we'll pause and either enable tokenizer_v2 for more routes (if safe) or rollback.
Ivo (SRE): Note: if we need to rollback quickly, the fastest path is to promote previous sha for the region: `deploy-bot promote --target sha=4b7c9a --scope=us-east1`
Raj (oncall): Logged the rollback playbook in incident-runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/embed-rollback
Asha: I'll post post-canary readout once we hit the 20% decision point. Thanks team.
